properties.entry: SELECT C.CATEGORY_NAME, IFNULL(SUM(T.TRANS_AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T JOIN GROUP_CATEGORIES C ON T.GCATEGORY_NUM = C.GCATEGORY_NUM WHERE T.GROUP_NUM IN ( SELECT GROUP_NUM FROM GROUP_MEMBERS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'A' ) AND DATE_FORMAT(T.TRANS_DATE, '%Y-%m') = ? AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY C.CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(T.TRANS_DATE, '%Y-%m') AS TARGET_MONTH, IFNULL(SUM(T.TRANS_AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T WHERE T.GROUP_NUM IN ( SELECT GROUP_NUM FROM GROUP_MEMBERS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'A' ) AND T.TRANS_DATE >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(?, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 5 MONTH) AND T.TRANS_DATE < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(?, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(T.TRANS_DATE, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY TARGET_MONTH

INSERT INTO GROUP_TRANSACTIONS ( GROUP_NUM, PERIOD_NUM, GCATEGORY_NUM, USER_NUM, TRANS_AMOUNT, TRANS_DATE, TRANS_MEMO, USE_YN, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( ?, (SELECT MAX(PERIOD_NUM) FROM LEDGER_PERIODS WHERE GROUP_NUM = ? AND PERIOD_STATUS = 'O'), ?, ?, ?, STR_TO_DATE(?, '%Y-%m-%d'), ?, 'Y', NOW() )
SELECT T.*, C.CATEGORY_NAME FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T JOIN GROUP_CATEGORIES C ON T.GCATEGORY_NUM = C.GCATEGORY_NUM WHERE T.GTRANS_NUM = ?
UPDATE GROUP_TRANSACTIONS SET GCATEGORY_NUM = ?, TRANS_AMOUNT = ?, TRANS_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(?, '%Y-%m-%d'), TRANS_MEMO = ? WHERE GTRANS_NUM = ?
UPDATE GROUP_TRANSACTIONS SET USE_YN = 'N' WHERE GTRANS_NUM = ?

SELECT M.USER_NUM, U.USER_NICKNAME, IFNULL(SUM(T.TRANS_AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_SPENT FROM GROUP_MEMBERS M JOIN USERS U ON M.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM LEFT JOIN GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T ON M.GROUP_NUM = T.GROUP_NUM AND M.USER_NUM = T.USER_NUM AND T.PERIOD_NUM = ? AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE M.GROUP_NUM = ? AND M.MEMBER_STATUS = 'A' GROUP BY M.USER_NUM, U.USER_NICKNAME

SELECT T.GTRANS_NUM, DATE_FORMAT(T.TRANS_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS TRANS_DATE, T.TRANS_AMOUNT, T.TRANS_MEMO, C.CATEGORY_NAME, U.USER_NICKNAME FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T JOIN USERS U ON T.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM JOIN GROUP_CATEGORIES C ON T.GCATEGORY_NUM = C.GCATEGORY_NUM WHERE T.PERIOD_NUM = ? AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY T.TRANS_DATE DESC, T.GTRANS_NUM DESC
